description: Get one or many physical assessments by id with every measure registered in MFIT: weight, height, BMI, body fat %, fat and lean mass, waist-hip ratio, circumferences (cm), skinfolds (mm), protocol, goal, notes and next assessment date. Measures left blank are null. Includes `comparison` with the previous assessment of the same student and kind: for each measure present in both, previous value, current value and delta (current minus previous). If there is no earlier assessment, `comparison` is null. Data entered by the professional; no clinical interpretation or diagnosis. Get ids from mfit_list_physical_assessments.
name: mfit_get_physical_assessment
